commands:
set -e
EXPECTED_MAIN="15931fa8341784a308f8a8b9ea6ebd68279241fc"
git fetch origin main --quiet
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
for branch in   "fix/ble-field-regressions-2026-10-08"   "fix/ble-device-identity-capabilities-20261008"   "chore/ble-field-closeout-20261008"
do
  if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git push origin --delete "$branch"
  else
    printf 'BRANCH_ALREADY_ABSENT %s\n' "$branch"
  fi
done
printf 'BRANCH_CLEANUP_OK main=%s\n' "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
git ls-remote --heads origin | sed 's#.*refs/heads/##' | sort
